snippet.title: The Expanse: Osiris Reborn | Official Gameplay Trailer | Xbox Partner Preview 2026
snippet.description:
The Expanse: Osiris Reborn is a third-person action RPG set in the universe of The Expanse.

You’re no hero — just a mercenary caught in the wrong place at the wrong time, trying to keep your crew together and your ship running while the system closes in around you. Your choices will shape your story.

Coming Spring 2027 to Xbox Series X|S and Xbox on PC as an Xbox Play Anywhere title and with Xbox Game Pass.

Closed Beta begins April 22 on Xbox Series X|S for Founders who supported development.
